update_text: The Gunslinger is reborn! New look, new skins and a smaller download. Update now!
title: GUNSLINGER REBORN
message: New in 1.4.1: the Gunslinger has been completely redrawn as a hooded jetpack ranger who aims at whatever he's shooting. Glitch Samurai is easier to see, with glitch effects on his slashes, teleports and ult. Two new skins in the store: Blazing Inferno for the Blood King and Neon Ronin for Glitch Samurai. Your equipped skin now shows at camp, and the download is about 37 MB smaller. Join our Discord for codes and news!
